repo_notes.content: Jekyll plugin (Ruby >= 3.3) providing pack-agnostic inline SVG icons via Liquid tags. Each built-in icon pack (lucide, simple, custom) is an adapter resolving names to SVG sources and normalizing output — switching packs changes the icon, not the styling.

Tags: {% icon %} (default pack), {% icon_lucide %}, {% icon_simple %}, {% icon_custom %}, plus fleet-convention aliases {% lucide_icon %} etc. so templates written for jekyll-lucide drop in unchanged. Same-name collisions across packs are disambiguated by tag name.

{% icon %} resolves via a configurable search chain (default custom -> simple -> lucide); icon_flow.pack or a pack: parameter pins the lookup to one pack. Extra downloaded packs (Font Awesome, Tabler, Heroicons) become named packs via icon_flow.packs, reached through pack:, the search chain, or registry targets — Liquid registers tag names statically, so named packs get no {% icon_<name> %} tag.

{% icon_ref %} implements a central registry: icon_flow.registry maps semantic names (download, github, danger) to pack:name[:class] triples — call sites name intent, swapping a pack updates every usage.
Parameters: size: (named sizes xxs..xxl as em-relative values, or any nonnegative CSS length), class: merged onto the <svg>, title: rendered as <title> for accessibility.
See README.md for conventions and the trusted-publishing release workflow.
